digest.component_or_area: LLM gate run usage logging and telemetry
propositions: Gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth metrics (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, request/tool-call limits) in failure_usage() but discard them at write time, leaving only token counts in the durable record.
Ordinary gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing at all, making tuning decisions impossible without expensive re-instrumented runs.
The success path never computes tool-call shapes or wall-clock duration, creating asymmetry between success and failure rows and blocking control-group analysis.
Operators cannot distinguish a looping run from genuine breadth without re-running, because the durable record carries no tool-call signature data, only request totals.

The fix wires the existing failure_usage() reducer to the success path and persists its seven computed fields (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, request/tool_calls limits, max_consecutive_repeat, finish_reason) plus duration_s and ticket, with default gate-session sink at .rebar/usage.jsonl.
